name: commonplace
tagline_zh: 你的Agent不再瞎翻笔记——它直接执行带类型、带链接、经审核的Markdown。像维基一样跑，像代码一样准。
tagline_en: Your agent stops rummaging—it executes typed, linked, review-gated markdown. Runs like a wiki, precise like code.
desc_en: The theory of LLM wikis, running as one. A framework for agent-operated knowledge: typed, linked, review-gated markdown your agents execute.
why_zh: 同类工具只存不审，它把知识变成可执行协议，每个改动都过审核，Agent 用起来才敢信。
why_en: Others store, it governs—every edit is gated, so agents trust and execute, not guess.
